title: Public comments
summary: A public-comment record — one `public-comment/1.0.0` JSON per comment under `comments/`, and one `changeset/1.0.0` JSON per change-set under `changesets/`. Written by the public-comment tool as comments are triaged and change-sets agreed.

avatar.reads: a speech bubble with lines — comments received and grouped

rationale: Its own typology, beside `todo-items` rather than inside it (issue #2195): a public comment IS a todo subclass and the board reads it as one, so the directory declares both. But the record also holds change-sets, which are not todos, and the todo-items sweep reads Markdown front matter while these are JSON. Listing these families on `todo-items` would make every folio without a public-comment record report EXAMINED NOTHING.
description: public comments on a document under review, and the change-sets that group them — one JSON each. Written by `public-comment.ts`; a comment is a todo subclass (`public-comment/1.0.0` extends `todo/1.0.0`), a change-set is not.
